rows.name: Claude Agent SDK
rows.fixtureKind: Real retained SDK capture converted after unwrapping recorder messages; fictional public counterpart.
rows.surface: Harbor consumes Claude Code transcript records. Accepted SDK messages share part of that surface; this does not establish parity between Claude Code and Agent SDK.
rows.equivalence: Partial: 202 call-bearing and result-bearing tool identities agree. Native capture also records duplicate observations and 57 progress-only operations whose identities are absent from the converted call population.
rows.overlay: None. Core does not infer native failure flags or complete history.

rows.name: Codex
rows.fixtureKind: Real leaderboard rollout converted by Harbor; fictional public counterpart.
rows.surface: EBO retains app-server protocol records. Harbor expects rollout response_item records and did not convert the retained app-server sample.
rows.equivalence: Known loss in the real leaderboard same-run pair: 45 native calls, 44 converted calls. EBO app-server equivalence is unproven.
rows.overlay: Optional Codex overlay qualifies reordered outputs, original arguments and inference groups. It records the omitted-pending-call limitation.

rows.name: Devin CLI
rows.fixtureKind: Authored native chat messages converted by Harbor.
rows.surface: No retained Devin chat-message export accepted by the converter was located. EBO’s native boundary is ACP; the converter consumes chat messages.
rows.overlay: None. Missing inference counts and tool failure fields remain unknown.

rows.name: Cursor
rows.fixtureKind: Authored CLI events converted by Harbor.
rows.surface: The retained SDK stream did not produce CLI steps. Cursor CLI and Cursor SDK are separate source surfaces.
rows.equivalence: Unproven: no accepted real same-run pair.
rows.overlay: None. A conforming ATIF document remains readable regardless of the Cursor source surface.

rows.name: Pi
rows.fixtureKind: Qualified retained native session converted by Harbor 0.25.0; fictional public counterpart.
rows.surface: The converter accepts the retained pi-session.jsonl and selects its active branch. Inactive branches can be omitted.
rows.equivalence: Selected call/result populations checked on the same retained session; complete history and all semantic measures are not established.
rows.overlay: Optional Pi overlay interprets error and cache extensions. False error flags and zero-filled usage do not prove success or absent usage.

rows.name: Factory Droid
rows.fixtureKind: Authored ATIF selection of a recorded user message, Create call and result from a retained capture; the empty agent message is a format placeholder. The public counterpart has fictional values.
rows.surface: EBO reads the authored ATIF through core.
rows.equivalence: Not independent equivalence evidence: the ATIF selection was authored from native content.
rows.overlay: None. Native error status is not a standard ATIF field.

rows.name: OpenHands
rows.fixtureKind: Authored legacy event records converted by Harbor.
rows.surface: Retained Agent Server REST/WebSocket payloads did not convert: hook records violate the converter’s source vocabulary, and selected agent records produced no legacy-format steps.
rows.equivalence: Unproven: native Agent Server and the converter’s legacy event export differ.
rows.overlay: None. Core preserves recorded observations and declared metrics.

rows.name: DeepSeek Harness
rows.fixtureKind: Authored ATIF selection of actual messages, bash call and result from a retained native capture; fictional public counterpart.
rows.surface: The authored selection parses the native JSON argument string into ATIF’s argument object.
rows.equivalence: Not independent equivalence evidence: the ATIF selection was authored from native content.
rows.overlay: None. Missing inference and tool failure declarations remain unknown.
